title: The newcomer on Telegram: two questions in one message, and he answers the first
demonstrates: Slot 7 in writing: polite, short, an exclamation mark, and of two questions the first. He sends what he is given: three drafts go out untouched, and the one time he types for himself he drops half the question, so the customer has to ask again. He resolves.

scenario.who_writes: Somebody new, writing between other things.
scenario.what_happens: Price and whether to book: the draft answers both and Caleb sends it. Then 'tomorrow morning, and can I wait there': he types 'Yes ma'am, tomorrow at 8:30 works!' and the second half has to be asked again; the next draft answers it and he sends it.
